name: buddy
description: Claude Code buddy plugin: Quack the ASCII duck waddles above your prompt and talks back — or bring back your /buddy

character.title: Character id (see /buddy-personality)
character.description: The character drawn above the prompt; a pick in /buddy-personality overrides it for this machine, and picking this one there returns to it.

characterDir.title: Folder of your own character JSON files
characterDir.description: Each {id}.json in it is a character (see the plugin's schema/character.schema.json); an id shared with a built-in replaces the built-in. Empty: built-ins only.

motion.title: Walk along the prompt line
motion.description: Off: the character stands still and only animates in place.

questionMode.title: /buddy questions: fork (sees the chat, uses its cache), complete, or off
questionMode.description: fork: answers from a fork of this chat (same model, served from its prompt cache), or from quipModel before the chat's first reply, while the main turn runs, or when the fork gives no answer; complete: a fresh call on quipModel that does not see the chat; off: no model call.

quips.title: Model-written one-liners at the end of a turn (spends tokens)
quips.description: At the end of a turn that used a tool, one short call on quipModel for a one-line reaction.

quipModel.title: Model for quips and questions that do not fork
quipModel.description: An alias (haiku, sonnet) or a full model id.

quipCooldownSec.title: Minimum seconds between quips
quipCooldownSec.description: A quip waits at least this long after the previous one.

memory.title: How many recent exchanges the buddy remembers (0 = off)
memory.description: Counts exchanges, not lines or tokens: an exchange is a /buddy question with its answer (or the question alone if it got none), or one line the buddy said. They go into its next answer or quip, kept per session and per character; at most 30.

logLevel.title: Log level: error, info or debug
logLevel.description: What the plugin writes to logFile: error only failures; info also sessions, commands, asks and their outcomes, quips, menu picks; debug also question text, model result shapes and band decisions. Never your identity.

logFile.title: Log file (empty = no log file)
logFile.description: The default follows CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/buddy/buddy.log when it is set, ~/.claude/buddy/buddy.log when it is not. A path you give is used as written, with ~ as your home folder and a leading $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR as the config folder. One JSON line per record, retried when another session writes at the same moment, capped at 1 MB with one rotation (.1). /buddy log shows its path and last 20 lines. Empty: no log file; failures still go to the debug log.

ambiguousWidth.title: Ambiguous-width characters: narrow or wide
ambiguousWidth.description: How many columns your terminal gives East Asian ambiguous-width characters (a CJK locale often draws them wide): narrow 1, wide 2. The bubble and the sprite are laid out to it.
